mappings.assertion: TestS1SizeGuard (run by make lint) fails on a stale ratchet entry for a function no longer above 100 lines. narrowInheritedDependenciesWithOptionalAuthority is now the entry point: narrowRequest.check (required fields and selection shape before any state read), admitNarrowRequest (transition, lifecycle request, receipt replay), then inside the one lifecycleMutation callback newNarrowPass (checkNarrowProducer eligibility, authorNarrowSelections, computeInheritedDeps), narrowPass.run (per child: narrowSkipReason, planChild with protectedEdges/removableEdges/canonicalisation/direction check, adoptChild), auditProducer, ValidateCandidate and CompleteLifecycleRequest; logNarrowResult runs after the mutation. Edge classification and per-child planning live in narrow_inherited_edges.go. The key is removed from area_a4_test.go and the guard passes.

The seven existing narrow tests (barrier edges removed, sibling/concrete edges never removed, children not at initial status skipped and untouched, out-of-range selection fails closed with nothing persisted, mode all unchanged, mode none, replanned producer refused) run unchanged in what they assert. TestNarrowSkipReason_ClaimedWithLiveLease pins the live-lease reason the oracle cannot reach (an initial-status claim is a state the validator refuses); TestNarrowInheritedDependencies_LifecycleDecisions pins every pre-rewrite refusal as INVALID_INPUT/correct_input/none with producer and children unchanged; TestNarrowInheritedDependencies_IdentifiedRequestReplaysOriginalCompletion asserts COMPLETED then ALREADY_COMPLETED with changed=false and no second history entry.

TestOracleNarrowInheritedDependenciesPaths adds the six cases (skipped, unchanged, protected_edges, unresolvable_refused, out_of_range_refused, replay) with json, human and state goldens, the narrow-skipped and narrow-protected fixtures and five narrow-*.yaml inputs (unchanged, unresolvable, out-of-range and replay reuse the inherited fixture). They were committed in 9dfc4f251, an oracle-only commit that precedes the production edit, generated with regen -mode write-new from the unchanged production tree; regen -mode check -pkg ./internal/oracle/a4 reproduces them and every older A4 golden, which are untouched. The skipped case pins the non-initial-status and terminal reasons; the live-lease reason is unreachable in valid state and is pinned by the white-box test. Negative proofs, restored: disabling task_depends_on protection failed protected_edges; bypassing the skip check failed skipped. No existing oracle file, fixture or golden is edited.

The child action set is the ops type narrowAction (narrowed, unchanged, skipped), converted to string in NarrowedChild.Action; TestNarrowAction_SpellingsMatchWire asserts each spelling by literal. The operation passes LifecycleSafeAction/LifecycleEffects constants instead of literals, compares transition cardinality with models.CardinalityPerSubtask in both places and the replanned marker with models.ReplannedTransition. TestNarrowInheritedDependencies_LifecycleDecisions asserts the unchanged outcome, safe action and effects of each refusal.

The live TestOracleNarrowInheritedDependencies and TestOracleProceed run against their unchanged goldens under make test, with the six new goldens; proceed.go (computeInheritedDeps, perSubtaskChildID), dependency_rewrite.go, NarrowSelection, NarrowedChild, the result types, the CLI and commands are untouched.

TestEveryRatchetKeyIsInTheSnapshotOnceAndPlacedInOneArea and TestS1SizeGuard (make lint) pass with the narrowInheritedDependenciesWithOptionalAuthority key removed from area_a4_test.go; narrow_inherited_dependencies.go, narrow_inherited_edges.go and every function in them are within the S1 limits.
